description: Fork of exp303 (current dense LUT-LM SOTA, 1.6509 @ 8K, 602M) replacing the additive per-layer learned pos_emb of dim E=64 with RoPE on (q, k) right before SDPA (half-rotation form, base=10000). qk_joint LUT receives x directly; v is NOT rotated. Drops 6*512*64=196,608 learned positional params; RoPE buffers are non-persistent. All other hyperparams match exp303 exactly. Isolates the RoPE effect on dense LUT-LM (vs exp320 = sparse + RoPE). Together with exp303 (dense + learned), exp316 (sparse + learned), exp320 (sparse + RoPE), this 2x2 disentangles the contribution of each axis.
